For the nominal passing scenario, pull_request run and selected-App15368 checks share head SHA and check-suite binding. This proves observed publisher/event/revision association, not successful execution or native required-revision selection.

Both nominal passing jobs report failure, contain no steps, and have startup annotations stating failed account payments or a spending-limit increase is needed. The API does not distinguish which underlying account condition applies.
